# definitions.py

[简体中文](definitions.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../README.en.md)

Colors, fonts, paper sizes and every option enum.

This module is the constant registry of the English edition, the counterpart of the
definition module in the original Chinese edition.

**Design rule (enum or string, both work)**: wherever a parameter takes only a handful of
values you get an enum, and plain strings are always accepted as well. The point is to be
convenient without being error-prone:

| Parameter | Recommended (enum) | Also accepted (string) |
|---|---|---|
| Color | `ColorName.RED` | `"red"`, `"#ff0000"`, or the Chinese colour word |
| Font | `Font.SIMHEI` | `"SimHei"` / `"simhei.ttf"` |
| Fill rule | `FillRule.EVENODD` | `"evenodd"` |
| Dash style | `DashStyle.DASHED` | `"8 4"` |
| Cap / join | `StrokeCap.ROUND` | `"round"` |
| Line join | `StrokeJoin.ROUND` | `"round"` |
| Text alignment | `TextHAlign.MIDDLE` | `"middle"` |
| Font weight | `FontWeight.BOLD` | `"bold"` / `700` |
| Text decoration | `TextDecoration.UNDERLINE` | `"underline"` |
| Blend mode | `BlendMode.MULTIPLY` | `"multiply"` |
| Arrow style | `ArrowStyle.SOLID` | `"solid"` |
| Point style | `PointStyle.CROSS` | `"cross"` |
| Gradient units | `CoordUnits.USER_SPACE` | `"userSpaceOnUse"` |
| Export engine | `PDFMode.CHROME` | `1` |

Every public entry point normalises its arguments through `value_of()`, so the two
spellings can be mixed freely.

Example:

```python
from malight import Color, ColorName, Font, FillRule, DashStyle

pen.text(100, 100, "Heading", font=Font.SIMHEI, weight=FontWeight.BOLD)
pen.polygon(pts, fill_color=ColorName.TEAL, fill_rule=FillRule.EVENODD)
pen.line((0, 0), (100, 0), stroke_style=DashStyle.DASHED)

print(Color.RED)                 # "#ff0000" (138 named colours plus the 2 no-colour constants)
print(ColorName.RED)             # "red" (the common subset, as an enum)
print(Color.RGB(30, 144, 255))   # "#1e90ff"
print(Color.darken("#D75D72"))   # darken a colour
w, h = PaperSize.A4_portrait()   # A4 pixel size
```

## Classes and methods

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `value_of` | Return an enum member's value and pass anything else through unchanged; the internal entry point behind the enum-or-string convention. |

### `Color`

Color constants and color-arithmetic helpers.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `RGB(R=None, G=None, B=None)` | Build an RGB color and return a #rrggbb string. |
| `hex_of(name)` | Convert a color name (Chinese or English) to hex; unknown input is returned as-is. |
| `english_name(chinese_name)` | Look up the English color name for a Chinese one. |
| `random()` | Return a random hex color. |
| `invert(color)` | Invert the color (each channel becomes 255 minus its value). |
| `darken(color, amount=0.08)` | Darken a color. |
| `lighten(color, amount=0.08)` | Lighten a color. |
| `add_colors(colors, keep_alpha=False)` | Add several colors channel-wise, clamping each channel at 255. |
| `add(color1, color2, keep_alpha=False)` | Add two colors channel-wise, clamping each channel at 255. |
| `blend(base, top, alpha=0.5)` | Blend two colors by alpha, compositing the top color over the bottom one. |
| `blend_many(colors, alphas=None)` | Blend several colors in order. |
| `to_rgb(color)` | Convert any color to an (r, g, b) tuple with channels 0-255. |
| `rgb_to_hex(rgb)` | Convert an (r, g, b) tuple to a #rrggbb string. |

### `ColorName`

Common color enum - the enum half of the enum-plus-string pattern.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `of(value)` | Convert a color string or enum name into a ColorName member. |
| `hex_of(color)` | Return a color's hex value; Chinese and English names both work. |
| `list_names()` | List every enum member name. |

### `ChalkColor`

Chalk colors - a soft palette that looks like chalk on a blackboard.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `list()` | Return the full list of chalk colors. |

### `ColorScheme`

Preset color schemes; each entry is a list of colors.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `cyclic(index, scheme)` | Cyclic color pick - wraps to the start when the index exceeds the scheme length. |

### `VectorEffect`

SVG vector-effect.

### `ScreenResolution`

Common screen resolutions as (width, height).

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `PHONE()` | Common phone resolution 1080x2376. |
| `FULL_HD()` | Full HD 1920x1080. |
| `HD()` | HD 1280x720. |
| `HUAWEI_ENJOY_60X()` | Huawei Enjoy 60X: 1080x2376. |
| `HUAWEI_NOVA12()` | Huawei Nova 12: 1084x2412. |
| `HUAWEI_MATE50()` | Huawei Mate 50: 1224x2700. |

### `PaperSize`

Paper sizes in pixels.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `A3_landscape(sheets=1)` | A3 landscape (420mm x 297mm); sheets is the number of pages stacked vertically. |
| `A3_portrait(sheets=1)` | A3 portrait. |
| `A4_landscape(sheets=1)` | A4 landscape (297mm x 210mm). |
| `A4_portrait(sheets=1)` | A4 portrait. |
| `A5_landscape(sheets=1)` | A5 landscape. |
| `A5_portrait(sheets=1)` | A5 portrait. |
